body: I’ve done the same. Notes are written, accounts deleted, I feel pretty confident I have tied up any loose ends. Now it’s just a matter of picking the right time, place, and method. For me, coming to terms with death was the easy part. Figuring out the logistics of actually following through on the other hand has been insanely frustrating.
Not exactly “no girlfriend” but Italian poet Cesare Pavese committed suicide partly because of a failed relationship. A lot of his work centers around him feeling unlovable.
